riddles.apple: I can be red or green, I grow on trees, and I keep the doctor away.
riddles.book: I have pages but no life, a spine but no bones, and stories to tell.
riddles.bowtie: I am a knot worn around the neck, shaped like a butterfly, often with a tuxedo.
riddles.candle: I have a wick and wax, I give light when burned, and I melt away.
riddles.cloud: I float in the sky, fluffy and white or dark and grey, bringing rain.
riddles.cup: I have a handle and hold your hot tea or coffee.
riddles.door: I have a handle or knob, and you open me to enter or leave a room.
riddles.envelope: I hold letters inside me, and you lick me to seal me shut.
riddles.eyeglasses: I sit on your nose, have two lenses, and help you see clearly.
riddles.guitar: I have a neck and strings, and you strum me to make music.
riddles.hammer: I have a heavy metal head and handle, used to drive nails into wood.
riddles.hat: I sit on top of your head, keeping you warm or shading you from the sun.
riddles.ice cream: I am cold, sweet, and creamy, served in a cone or bowl, and melt in the heat.
riddles.leaf: I grow on branches, turn colors in autumn, and fall to the ground.
riddles.scissors: I have two sharp blades and handles, used to cut paper or cloth.
riddles.star: I twinkle in the night sky, a giant ball of burning gas far away.
riddles.t-shirt: I am a simple piece of clothing with short sleeves and a round neck.
riddles.pants: I have two legs and cover your lower body, fastened at the waist.
riddles.lightning: I am a sudden flash of bright light in a storm, followed by a loud boom.
riddles.tree: I have a tall trunk, roots, branches, and leaves, providing shade and oxygen.
